summary: Harder framed Oct. 7 around Israel's right to self-defense before calling for a bilateral ceasefire. He voted yes on codifying the IHRA definition, on H.R. 6090 applying IHRA standards in education enforcement, and on condemning 'from the river to the sea' as antisemitic. Vote for Peace opposed his general bid; the Jewish Democratic Council of America and DMFI PAC endorsed him. A 2026 vote against $3.3 billion in military aid complicates but does not offset the record.
